description: 新增主页与笔记库、批量整理、持久分类、遮字胶带、自定义纸张颜色、无缝页面、智能插点、全屏浏览及触控工作台；改进保存恢复、原生格式兼容性与性能
windows_registration_policy: 注册或安装前比较已安装和已注册版本，旧版本不能覆盖较新版本。
compatibility_policy: 对外名称、安装目录、用户数据和 QSettings 使用 NotabilityEditor；启动时将旧 NotabilityViewer 日志、数据及设置校验迁移到新位置并删除旧项，成功安装后按归属清理旧程序、卸载记录和快捷方式，保留笔记内容及 NTB 格式兼容标识。跨名称安装与注册仍统一比较版本。
license_scope: Original project contributions only; see LICENSE_SCOPE and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.

windows.library_policy: Open edits original NTB/NOTE; import copies into the managed library. Classifying managed notes moves files; external notes keep their original paths.

android_tablet.status: local backend connected browser UI; native Android APK pending
views: note editor with side-by-side page manager
android_tablet.ntb_engine_status: local NTB open / edit / atomic save / download
android_tablet.save_policy: automatic durable snapshots; native NTB flush on home return, graceful exit, or before next open; force-kill recovery on restart

limits.original_images_and_text: preserved protected native content; annotation supported

features: 多分组原生纸张与真实尾页映射
原生线段、曲线、箭头、多边形和椭圆显示及擦除
原生形状页面复制与重排
旧式彩色纸张、点阵及横线预览
多分组图片插入与跨页移动
向心三次曲线智能插点
compatibility_update.paper_texture_preview: 旧式纹理使用底色近似；原始纸张设置在 NTB 中保留不变。

seamless_pages.menu: 页面 → 页面无缝衔接（支持跨页绘制）
seamless_pages.menu_scope: 仅顶部菜单栏，不在页面管理弹出菜单中显示
seamless_pages.detail_view: 笔记正文勾选后连续衔接，取消勾选恢复页间间隔；页面管理缩略图保持原样
seamless_pages.performance: 跨页复用已渲染内容，只更新新增笔迹及局部绘制区域
seamless_pages.undo: 一次绘制或擦除的所有跨页改动可一次撤销或重做
seamless_pages.storage: 按原生页面边界拆分，保留接缝笔宽；关闭衔接后仍按页显示和保存

smart_interpolation.geometry: 向心 Catmull-Rom 三次曲线，按真实输入局部增量生成
smart_interpolation.scope: 之后绘制的画笔、荧光笔和遮字胶带
preserved: 撤销、擦除、显示、PDF 导出和 NTB 保存回读
smart_interpolation.performance: 稳定段只构建一次，只有尚未固定的笔迹尾部在输入时重建

io_optimization.immutable_table_fields: Read validated immutable FlatBuffer field offsets once; mutable repair buffers stay live.
io_optimization.shared_native_layers: Resolve native image and stroke layer state once per load; text parser skips unrelated events.
io_optimization.deferred_edit_geometry: Register native Bezier bounds without flattening every page into editable polylines.
io_optimization.save_pipeline: Commit the fully validated native stage directly when no private image conversion is needed.

structural_save.reuse: Operation-local immutable page/graph/structure results; bounded cache, discarded on completion or cancellation.
structural_save.schema: Validate full known schema without rebuilding throwaway copies; final compaction still checks relocated graph and preserved bytes.
structural_save.progress: Report native validation work before archive copy; cancellation checked during graph traversal and event validation.

background_save.snapshot: Freeze an immutable revision; newer ink/image/page edits remain dirty until their own snapshot commits.
background_save.interaction: Keep canvas and tools active; show progress and cancellation in the status bar.
background_save.queue: Coalesce repeated Ctrl+S requests into one latest-revision follow-up; never overlap writers.
background_save.continuity: Keep canvas, zoom, scroll, undo and original assets alive after Save/Save As; avoid whole-note reload.
background_save.recovery: Private local recovery snapshots are separate from explicit NTB saves; failures retain unsaved edits.
background_save.notification: No modal completion/no-change dialogs; errors and recovery copies still report clearly.
background_save.native_snapshot: Retain opaque native ink on unchanged per-page originals; snapshot only changed/new-page ink, without reparsing the entire notebook on the GUI thread.

tap_rendering.screen: Append committed pen/highlighter/tape strokes to cached page content; retain alpha, ordering and undo branch identity.
tap_rendering.history: Single-page continuous gestures remain single draw operations; cross-page gestures retain one undo with append metadata.
tap_rendering.thumbnails: Invalidate only pages touched by new ink and debounce replacement previews for 300 ms.

page_priority.first_frame: Paint the restored/current visible pages before scheduling background preparation.
page_priority.background: One low-priority worker prepares immutable edit geometry and screen rasters for up to four visible/nearby pages; jumping replaces queued work.
page_priority.bounds: Prefetch raster jobs use at most half the 96 MiB screen-cache budget; original geometry retains an eight-page LRU.
page_priority.correctness: Discard outdated raster results after edits, zoom and cache invalidation; cancel queued work and join the active worker before closing the archive.
page_priority.scope: Native structure validation and page bounds registration still precede display; rendering and editable polylines are prepared by viewing priority.

save_index.scope: Bounded immutable parse cache owned by each save session; mutable buffers bypass cache; final output validation retained.

study_tape.reveal: 临时揭开仅影响当前阅读；保存、缩略图和导出保持遮盖
study_tape.storage: 原生 Tape 工具类型 3、FixedWidth 样式 1、原生图案字段 0–8
study_tape.compatibility: 通过原生胶带样本的读取、编辑、保存和重开验证；官方 Notability 导入未作实机验证。

viewport_rendering.page_capability: validated after first viewport; original strict validators retained
viewport_rendering.stale_results: page identity, history revision, epoch and display options checked
viewport_rendering.editing: existing incremental pen/highlighter and cross-page eraser retained

architecture.save_snapshot: immutable shared components; mutable writer input created on worker
architecture.migration_scope: document history and save values; existing Qt adapters retained

user_data.migration: Import legacy QSettings only if no valid user-data index exists.
